title: IELTS API: a free, no-authentication REST API and open dataset for IELTS preparation research
description: Archived release of the IELTS API source code and datasets. v1.1.0 adds a metadata index of the open CEFR-graded practice corpus (1,804 items: graded listening lessons, listening and reading full tests, 1,232 graded reading lessons) served at /v1/practice. Cite this record, or the version-specific DOI, when you use the API or the datasets in research.
